This semester was unique in that we had many opportunities to try different things. I know there are things I need to do differently for next semester. I also know there are things I am excited about that I learned to do better this semester. Please let me know your thoughts on what we can do next semester to make your experience more positive. Please tell me, in your own words, what we can do to help various areas of each class.

 

The final will be graded pass fail. You may get bonus points for great answers.

 

Pick your favorite five questions to answer

And

Please share your most relatable meme after completing this semester.

 

  1. Describe the biggest obstacle you have overcome this semester
  2. What was the biggest advantage of the change in course delivery this semester?
  3. What was the greatest opportunity you took advantage of this semester?
  4. Describe your plan for getting to know about job opportunities and expectations for companies you would like to work for.
  5. Describe your best degree related experience this semester.
  6. Share three resume bullets related to how you were able to adjust to distance learning this semester
  7. Share your favorite book or tutorial that has helped you towards your career this semester.
  8. Describe three certifications you would like to earn over the summer.
  9. What was your favorite non-school activity from this semester?
  10. What was your biggest non-school challenge from this semester?
  11. Attendance: I want to know you are engaged with this class. In the past I could walk around and see what was up on your screens. Times have changed. What would you like to see for an attendance policy next semester? Here is the current idea. I will call roll every day we have class. This will be for your attendance grade. You simply need to be logged into zoom and let me know you are here, either by voice, or video, or chat, or discord. 
  12. Quiz grade: For CS 1 and CS 2, Fridays will be our show and tell days. For Discrete Structures, Computer Architecture, Software Engineering, and Algorithms, we will schedule these as needed. You will have a quiz grade every show and tell day. This will simply be where you will need to share your screen or video or unmute yourself and participate in our show and tell time. You should either show your own work or interact with others as they share their work. This is an idea. I am happy to make improvements on this idea. I know that this will be a burden for some. My goal is to ensure that you are ready to log into a remote meeting and be an active participant on a regular basis. I feel like this is a marketable skill, and I want you all to have ample practice in our classroom. Please let me know your thoughts and how I can improve my thought process on this.
  13. Facilities: What can I do to improve the classroom environment? I tried to have a quality headset for zoom meetings. I have been using the stock camera on my laptop, or the cameras I have for video. I felt like Discord also provided a way to communicate with the class and others outside the class. What can I do better to help make the environment better? I have heard that others are using overlays on top of Zoom. Is this something that would be beneficial? It has been requested that we add longer ethernet cords and power strips at some of the stations here on campus to allow people to bring their own computers and connect to class. Are there other things we can do to improve course delivery? One policy I am going to change for next year is that I am going to share multiple links in the syllabus for my dropbox folder. One will be for the curated class videos. A second will be for my storage drive where I keep my videos. And I will only use 1 link for all my classes and office hours and meetings. That way we don’t need to ever ask what the link is and you know where to go to find me if you need anything.
  14. Show and tell: I really enjoy seeing the work you have done and the codes you have written. Sharing your learning and how you think about programming helps me be a better teacher. I enjoy hearing about what you struggled with and what you are excited about. I like working with you to help you make progress on your path. I feel show and tell is a great way to do this. I feel that it is good for everyone in the class to know where people are, what people are struggling with, and what people can do to make their code feel more personal. Getting to bond with classmates and get help on your programming is worth a third of the class to me. What can I do to make as many people as possible share in our Friday show and tell? What can we do to make it more fun? What can we do to encourage the people who are struggling? What can we do to help the ones that are falling behind? Please help me improve my thinking on this.
  15. Office Hours: Not many people came to office hours this semester. Do the zoom office hours work? Are there other times people would like to have office hours? Do we want to give out bonus points for the best office hour question of the week?

Name Assignment Due
HW 1 2.3 # 5, 6, 7
2.4 # 5, 6, 9
2.6 # 3, 4, 5		 Monday, Jan 18th

 

You will work through the problems and upload your answer to the discussion. Please make comments on at least 3 of the other solution sets you see.

The main portion of this class is the process for working through a problem. Every problem should follow a similar process. For each question you answer, you should include five parts.

  • (5 points) A sentence or summary of what the question is asking for
  • (5 points) A list of references and resources to help answer the question
  • (5 points) A brief description of general assumptions to help solve the problem, as well as key observations from the references
  • (5 points) Your work showing your path from the question to your solution
  • (5 points) A justification of your answer that explains why you believe this is the most correct answer
